description: Structured registration data for a domain from RDAP, the successor to WHOIS: registrar, creation, expiry and last-changed dates, age in days, status flags, nameservers and whether DNSSEC is signed. Use it to spot a newly registered or soon-to-expire domain. 5 free calls per day across all tools; pass `key` to use a prepaid balance (0.005 USDC per call).
name: domain_registration
